process.name: Discovery
process.text: A scoping call where we map goals, audience and constraints. You leave with a written brief, whether or not you hire us.

process.name: Design
process.text: Wireframes first, visuals second. You review flat screens before any production code is written.

process.name: Build
process.text: Weekly builds on a staging link. You watch it come together instead of waiting for a reveal.

process.name: Launch & run
process.text: We ship, hand over the keys and the documentation, then stay on for content, campaigns and upkeep if you want us.

faq.q: How long does a website take to build?
faq.a: It depends on the scope. After a scoping call you get a written brief and a proposal with a timeline, usually within 48 hours, and you can follow weekly builds on a staging link.

faq.q: Can my team edit the website after launch?
faq.a: Yes. Sites are built to be edited by your own team, and at handover you get the documentation that explains how.

faq.q: Who owns the website, code and accounts?
faq.a: You do. Every engagement ends with you owning every file, repository and account.

faq.q: Do you work with businesses outside Pakistan?
faq.a: Yes. We have built sites for businesses in Pakistan and the United States, and we work with clients over WhatsApp, email and video calls.
